questions.prompt: The soldiers, exhausted by the long war, encouraged each other.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs, longō bellō dēfessī, inter sē cohortātī sunt.

questions.prompt: The two brothers, though rivals, always used to help each other.
questions.answer: Duo frātrēs, quamquam aemulī, semper inter sē iuvābant.

questions.prompt: After the battle the Gauls gave hostages to each other.
questions.answer: Post proelium Gallī obsidēs inter sē dedērunt.

questions.prompt: We love each other, although the seas divide us.
questions.answer: Amāmus inter nōs, quamquam maria nōs dīvidunt.

questions.prompt: You were exhorting one another with fierce shouts.
questions.answer: Inter vōs saevīs clāmōribus cohortābāminī.

questions.prompt: The savage kings, when peace had been made, embraced each other.
questions.answer: Rēgēs saevī, pāce factā, inter sē complexī sunt.

questions.prompt: The fishermen, tossed by the storm, called out to each other.
questions.answer: Piscātōrēs, tempestāte iactātī, inter sē clāmāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The maidens at the temple were whispering secrets to each other.
questions.answer: Virginēs ad templum arcāna inter sē susurrābant.

questions.prompt: The philosophers, seeking the truth, kept contradicting each other.
questions.answer: Philosophī, vēritātem quaerentēs, inter sē repugnābant.

questions.prompt: When the enemy had been overcome, the leaders congratulated each other.
questions.answer: Hostibus superātīs, ducēs inter sē grātulātī sunt.

questions.prompt: We were sending letters to each other across the wide sea.
questions.answer: Inter nōs per lātum mare epistulās mittēbāmus.

questions.prompt: The citizens, split by faction, distrusted each other.
questions.answer: Cīvēs, factiōne dīvīsī, inter sē diffīdēbant.

questions.prompt: The old men, sitting beneath the tower, told each other tales.
questions.answer: Senēs, sub turrī cōnsīdentēs, inter sē fābulās nārrābant.

questions.prompt: The victors and the vanquished spared each other.
questions.answer: Victōrēs et victī inter sē pepercērunt.

questions.prompt: Before the war the generals exchanged gifts with each other.
questions.answer: Ante bellum imperātōrēs dōna inter sē commūtāvērunt.

questions.prompt: You two, although friends, were deceiving each other.
questions.answer: Vōs, quamquam amīcī, inter vōs fallēbātis.

questions.prompt: The wild beasts in the forest were tearing each other apart.
questions.answer: Ferae in silvā inter sē lacerābant.

questions.prompt: With their weapons thrown down, the men embraced each other.
questions.answer: Armīs prōiectīs, virī inter sē amplexī sunt.

questions.prompt: The rowers, weary with toil, urged each other to hold out.
questions.answer: Rēmigēs, labōre fessī, inter sē hortābantur ut perstārent.

questions.prompt: The gleaming stars seem to answer each other in the night.
questions.answer: Stēllae splendentēs nocte inter sē respondēre videntur.

questions.prompt: The exhausted allies helped each other on the rampart.
questions.answer: Sociī dēfessī in vallō inter sē adiuvābant.

questions.prompt: The merchants, greedy for gain, were cheating each other.
questions.answer: Mercātōrēs, lucrī cupidī, inter sē fraudābant.

questions.prompt: In the midst of danger we promised aid to each other.
questions.answer: In mediō perīculō auxilium inter nōs pollicitī sumus.
